capabilities: Add a summary view to existing Bases that groups notes into one row per group
Compute Count, Sum, Average, Min, Max, Earliest, Latest, date range and custom formula summaries
Edit, add and remove summary columns through header and footer menus
Sort, resize columns and copy or export results as CSV or Markdown table
Exclude folders from group counts and summaries
extras: The README states the plugin writes to the clipboard only for Copy as CSV or Copy as Markdown table actions and never reads the clipboard.
intentEvidence: A plain summary table for the Bases you already have. Add it as another view on an existing Base
problem: A Bases table lists every note when the user often only wants per-group answers like totals, averages, or latest dates, and there is no native summary view.
summary: Grouped summary view for Bases that collapses filtered notes into one row per group with count, sum, average, date range and custom formula totals.
